question: Ferris is always dressed cutely, but has he ever dressed in a way that was dashing or manly? Also, if Crusch-sama has seen that, how did Crusch-sama react?
answer: If Ferris were to dress like a man in front of Crusch-sama, that would be a betryal of Crusch-sama, so he won't do it. Along those lines, the first time that Ferris dressed in the royal guard uniform and showed her, Crusch-sama took him around the mansion, and showed him off to all the servants.
